title: Filter your notifications
body: Jump between matches, replies, messages, and product updates without digging through one long feed.

title: Watch live rounds in one place
body: See who is live, catch recent rounds, and browse clips from the Watch hub.

title: Schedule the next round
body: Post a time, collect RSVPs, and give both sides a clear place to meet.

title: Debate real humans, live
body: Post a motion, pick a side, and argue another person in the in-page video room. The same AI judge writes the ballot.

title: Voice rounds
body: Argue out loud. The AI cuts in, takes POIs, and talks back at conversation speed.

title: Direct messages
body: Find a sparring partner on the board and message them to set up a round.

title: 15 formats, one judge
body: Each format gets its own rules, speech order, evidence norms, and judging lens.

title: Faster ballots
body: Reasons for decision and speaker points land the moment the round ends, not minutes later.
